description: Answers "loudest cities in the US", "quietest cities in the US", "how noisy is Boston", "what share of Miami hears highway noise". Share of residents exposed to ≥60 dB / ≥70 dB transportation noise for all 297 US cities of 100,000+ residents, computed from the federal BTS 2020 National Transportation Noise Map, not estimated. Pass a city for detail, omit for the ranking. Street address → get_address_noise; neighborhoods → get_neighborhood_noise.

limit.description: How many ranked cities when no city is given (default 10)

name: get_us_city_noise_exposure

pct_ge60_db.description: Share of residents exposed to >=60 dB (%)

title: US city transportation-noise exposure (measured)
